title: Classic Mujaddara
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish made with lentils and rice, perfect for a comforting meal. This recipe serves 4-6 people and is ready in under an hour.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the brown rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the split red lentils, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice and lentils are tender.
Fluff the mujaddara with a fork and stir in the chopped parsley.
